onscreen_text.text: But how do you get dense brows?

Bimatoprost 0.03% Carruthers, J., Beer, K., Carruthers, A., Coleman, W. P., Draelos, Z. D., Jones, D., Goldman, M. P., Pucci, M. L., VanDenburgh, A., Weng, E., & Whitcup, S. M. (2016). Bimatoprost 0.03% for the treatment of eyebrow hypotrichosis. Dermatologic Surgery, 42(5), 608–617.
DR. JEAN CARRUTHERS, MD PROF. BRITISH COLUMBIA

Minoxidil 2% Lee, S., Tanglertsampan, C., Tanchotikul, M., & Worapunpong, N. (2014). Minoxidil 2% lotion for eyebrow enhancement: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, split-face comparative study. The Journal of Dermatology, 41(2), 141-144.

transcript.text: Everyone knows that denser eyebrows typically look more attractive.
But how do you actually increase your eyebrow density?
Carruthers and colleagues ran a large trial on people with sparse eyebrows,
and applied once or twice daily bimatoprost,
which significantly improved eyebrow fullness by month seven compared to placebo.
So it may be worth consulting a dermatologist about this particular option.
You could also ask them about minoxidil.
Lee and colleagues put minoxidil on one brow and placebo on the other in forty people.
After just sixteen weeks, the treated side came out ahead on brow count, diameter, and overall appearance.
Now, this last option only works if you already have a decent amount of brow density.
It can look too obvious if your brows are truly sparse, but if your brows are only somewhat thin,
and you really want that extra-bold look, microblading is the most effective option.
You can see from this example that the semi-permanent tattoo of fine hairs underneath gives the actual brow hairs themselves bold support.
And if you want us to analyze your face, including your brow density, click the link in bio at Qoves.com.

narrative_arc: Highlight brow density as a key aesthetic factor.
Introduce Bimatoprost study results for sparse brows.
Present Minoxidil study results as an alternative medical solution.
Explain Microblading as a cosmetic solution suitable for moderately thin brows.
Direct viewer to Qoves.com for personal face and brow analysis.
